owner.name: Mara Lindqvist
owner.subtitle: Landscape architecture · a fictional demo portfolio
owner.description: A fictional demo portfolio, built from the same engine as the Silicode keyboard.

projects.name: Harbour Steps
projects.lede: A flight of wide stone steps that turned a car park into the town’s living room.
body: Two hundred metres of quay where people now sit, swim and watch the ferries come in. The steps double as a flood defence, rising in terraces so a storm surge reaches the stone and never the shops.

projects.name: Rooftop Orchard
projects.lede: Forty fruit trees on top of a supermarket.
body: Shallow-rooted apple and quince varieties on a lightweight soil build-up, harvested by the people who live in the flats next door.

projects.name: The Salt Marsh Study
projects.lede: Five years watching a marsh decide where to grow.
body: A long field study of how planted salt marsh migrates as the sea rises, and what designers should stop trying to control.

projects.name: Studio Lindqvist
projects.lede: A small office that draws by hand before it draws on screen.
body: Six people, one long table, and a rule that every project starts with a site walk at dawn.

projects.name: Courtyard Commons
projects.lede: A shared garden negotiated between ninety households.
body: Every bench, bed and lamp was voted on. The design work was mostly listening, and then making the compromise look intentional.

projects.name: Field Notes
projects.lede: An evening course on reading a landscape.
body: Twelve walks, one notebook each, and no slides.
